description: d_min=0.08 -- production tail months 60-72 holds at 500-600 bbl/mo with very slow decline, suggesting terminal decline rate ~8%. Baseline d_min=0.05 causes forecast to drop too fast in holdout (R2_outsample=-0.88).

b_initial=1.0 -- fitted b=0.8046 with R2_outsample=-0.88 suggests curve declines too steeply in extrapolation. Higher b_initial may escape local minimum and find more hyperbolic solution that matches the slow late-time decline (500-600 bbl/mo months 60-72).
smoothing_window=5 -- production has frequent dips (month 26: 749, month 40: 482, month 53: 343) causing noisy fit. Wider smoothing should reduce overfitting and improve holdout extrapolation.
qi_guess_strategy=max3 -- baseline uses 'first' (7464 bbl) but peak is 9189 at month 2. Averaging top 3 months gives better qi initial guess, may shift optimizer bounds and improve holdout forecast.

outlier_window=7 -- sharp dips at months 26 (749), 40 (482), 53 (343), 56 (320) escape narrow 3-month rolling median. Wider 7-month window should flag these as outliers, giving fitter cleaner training data.

di_initial=0.9 -- optimizer converges to di=0.7486 from di_initial=0.5 but R2_outsample=-0.88 means poor extrapolation. Starting from 0.9 may find different basin in parameter space given the shut-in discontinuity.
outlier_threshold=0.50 -- more aggressive outlier detection to remove noisy months (749, 482, 343 bbl dips) that may be distorting the fit. Current threshold=0.30 only catches the 2 shut-in zeros.

significance_threshold=0.30 -- lowering from 0.50 widens significant peak set from 4595 bbl to 2757 bbl threshold. Post-shut-in peaks (month 15: 2214) still below but months 7-9 (~3200-3900) may now qualify, potentially moving decline start.

smoothing_window=6 -- wider smoothing spreads the shut-in zeros' influence, creating a trough-then-peak pattern post-shut-in in the smoothed curve. May change peak detection behavior and the all_peaks list.
qi_multiplier_upper=10.0 -- doubling qi upper bound from 5x to 10x. Wider parameter space may let optimizer escape current basin (qi=10605, di=0.75, b=0.80) which gives R2_outsample=-0.88.
